claim_scope: GEARS GSE90063 K562 TF pool 7d entrant: temporal sensitivity / early-bridge probe paired with 13d in the K562 13d/7d temporal panel. Outputs support temporal stratification of bridge readouts.
input_space_description: GSE90063 K562 TF pool 7d single-feature cells, log-normalized to target_sum=10000.
output_space_description: Subtract shared control pseudobulk from GEARS predicted expression to export perturbation-level predicted_shift. The 45 atlas gene symbols (intersection of K562 h5ad and the HCC atlas) constitute the complete GEARS output space.
